method.description: For each of 18 lines, sweep coefficients c, a, and b independently across every exact critical value where the moving line passes through an existing vertex; for slope coefficients also include parallel-event walls. Score every critical wall and every open interval sample with an integer-determinant proposal scorer.

interpretation: The verified 93 arrangement is locally resistant to every one-line one-coordinate wall move in this bounded sweep. This is route information, not an upper-bound proof and not evidence that 94 is unattainable.
next_search_direction: Move from single-coordinate local walls to combinatorial/order-type search or multi-line coordinated moves; keep H1-12 upper-bound audit independent.
claim_boundary: No 94 was found in this explicitly bounded neighborhood. Search failure does not establish a global upper bound, optimality of 93, or nonexistence of a 94 arrangement.
